analysis.primaryGoal: Drive action to start the Mindbloom program
analysis.audience: Potential customers seeking mental health treatment solutions

layoutPatterns: hero image with strong value proposition
visualStyle.imageStyle: Warm, lifestyle photography with natural outdoor and home settings, human-focused, motivating

copyStyle.urgency: Low to moderate: Emphasizes transformation and positive outcomes rather than immediate scarcity

reusablePatterns: Visual timeline communicating stages or benefits over time
Hero section with short, bold headline and emotional imagery
Two CTAs (primary action, secondary reassurance/question route)
Simple, conversational explanations of each customer journey stage
Footer navigation with direct resource links
risks: Outcome promises could be seen as medical claims if copied directly
Stepwise transformation visuals may oversimplify nuanced journeys when reused in other contexts
Heavy use of warm photography could be hard to replicate for other brands

confidence.notes: Almost all visible text is clearly readable throughout the email. Cautious on copy for legal/branding reasons.
